Order:

This Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India with the following prayer for:
"... pleased to issue a Writ, or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the Respondent Police in failing to take legal action on the petitioner's complaint through Spandana vide C.No. 4786/ CCC / G2/
2021, Dated 13.12.2021 and to investigate the same against the culprits, meanwhile the 5th respondent police harassing the petitioner without having any jurisdiction is illegal, arbitrary, unconstitutional and contrary to the provisions of Cr.P.0 and consequently direct the respondents No. 3 86 4 to take legal action on the petitioner's complaint dated 13.12.2021 by conducting fair investigation forthwith and to pass....."

2. Heard Sri M.Parameswara Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri V. Farooq, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home.

opennyai_summary.decision:
This Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India with the following prayer for:
"... pleased to issue a Writ, or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of the Respondent Police in failing to take legal action on the petitioner's complaint through Spandana vide C.No. 4786/ CCC / G2/
2021, Dated 13.12.2021 and to investigate the same against the culprits, meanwhile the 5th respondent police harassing the petitioner without having any jurisdiction is illegal, arbitrary, unconstitutional and contrary to the provisions of Cr.P.0 and consequently direct the respondents No. 3 86 4 to take legal action on the petitioner's complaint dated 13.12.2021 by conducting fair investigation forthwith and to pass....."
Recording the same, the writ petition is disposed of.
However, the police are directed to follow due process of law regarding the crime registered against the petitioner.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
